rules.rule: Every method must declare read/write effect, idempotency, scope, marketplace and owner-confirmation level; only read or proven-idempotent calls may retry automatically.
No connector may default to production, EBAY_US or a third-party CORS proxy when environment, marketplace, store binding or credential reference is missing.
Tokens, request bodies, order data and listing data must not enter debug logs or an unadmitted proxy.
POST, refund, shipment, publish, price, inventory and advertising writes may not be blindly replayed after 429 or 5xx; query current state and require approval/readback.
Inventory API listings record writer ownership and cannot be modified concurrently by Seller Hub, Trading API, ERP and Inventory API.
Conflicting official release-note routes remain conflicting evidence with URL, version and date; SDK self-reported coverage is not current field authority.

regression_cases.scenario: Retry a shipment POST after a 5xx without checking the existing fulfillment state.
Send seller OAuth and order data through an unadmitted public CORS proxy.
Treat one eBay release-note route as authoritative when another official route has a different latest version.
Modify an Inventory API-owned listing through a second writer without ownership reconciliation.
